title: Bounds for a reciprocal floor
statement: For every real number $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le 1/2$, let $m=\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor$, where the floor is the greatest integer not exceeding $1/\delta$. Then $\delta\le 1/m\le 2\delta$, and $1/m-\delta\le 2\delta^2$.
